items.why: WTI jumped after the EIA reported an unexpected 8.6 million barrel US crude draw, Hurricane Isaias shut in Gulf production, and Hormuz shipping threats kept a risk premium bid.
The fear gauge slid as the Dow and small caps rallied on falling Treasury yields, calming the equity risk tone into the afternoon.
Gold snapped a three session losing streak as Treasury yields and the dollar eased, drawing safe haven flows while tech sold off.
Nvidia fell with the broader chip wipeout as AI trade doubts spread; CEO Jensen Huang also publicly addressed CoreWeave's stock plunge.

market_note: Dow futures up 1.1%, S&P near flat, Nasdaq futures down 0.25%.
summary: Stocks are splitting today: the Dow and small caps are gaining as falling Treasury yields ease rate fears, while tech and chips are sliding on doubts about AI investment returns.
